title: Agent Council
markdown:
**What it is:** The settings page for the agents behind the Executive. You choose how thorough answers are, add instructions to any agent, and change each agent's model and prompt. Changes apply to everyone who uses this Executive.

**What it does:**

- **Quality** sets every agent's model and deep reasoning at once: **Fast**, **Balanced** or **Thorough**.
- Add **Additional instructions** to any agent, such as "Quote figures in EUR".
- Change an agent's role, model, deep reasoning, system prompt and research focus.
- Write or edit voice personas for the Executive.
- Test unsaved settings with a one-off question before you save.
- Restore an earlier version, or reset an agent to its built-in settings.

**How to use:**

1. Open **Settings → Advanced → Agent Council**.
2. Pick a preset under **Quality**:
   - **Fast**: a small, fast model for every agent, with deep reasoning off.
   - **Balanced**: each agent's built-in model and deep-reasoning setting.
   - **Thorough**: the largest model for the Executive and the specialists, with deep reasoning on where the model supports it. Background helpers keep their built-in settings.
   A confirmation asks first. Prompts and instructions are not changed, and the earlier settings move to each agent's history. A preset is greyed out when this install offers none of its models. If you change one agent's model by hand, a **Custom** badge appears next to **Quality**.
3. Under **Your agents**, each card shows the agent's name, its area and a status line: the model name, **Custom ·** followed by the model name when its model differs from the preset, or **Has your instructions** when you changed its instructions, prompt, role or research focus. **Show all agents** adds the internal and helper agents. **Show fewer agents** hides them again.
4. Click a card to open the agent in a side panel. It opens on **Additional instructions** (up to 4,000 characters). They are added after the agent's built-in prompt on every call, so the agent keeps getting updates to that prompt. Clear the box to remove them.
5. Click **Save**. The change applies on the next message. **Cancel** drops your edits. Closing the panel another way with unsaved edits asks "Discard your unsaved changes to this agent?"

**Advanced settings:**

Click **Advanced settings** in the agent's panel to see every setting. The panel widens into tabs. Your browser remembers this choice for every agent. **Simple view** goes back, and unsaved edits carry over. The two helper agents that are only a model setting (the fast utility model and the research model) always open here.

- **Model** tab: **Role** (its one-line job), **Model** (pick a provider, then a model; the agent's default is marked *(default)*), and **Deep reasoning** (slower, more thorough thinking; not available on Haiku models). The fast utility model has no deep-reasoning switch.
- **Instructions** tab: the same **Additional instructions** box as the simple view.
- **Prompt** tab: **System prompt**, the agent's full instructions. Editing it replaces the built-in prompt, so later updates to that prompt will not reach this agent. **Restore default prompt in editor** puts the original back. Specialists also have **Research focus**, the topics they watch in background research scans, with **Restore default research focus in editor**.
- **Test** tab: under **Test this draft**, type a question and click **Run test**. It uses the unsaved settings in the tabs and saves nothing. The fast utility model has no Test tab.
- **History** tab: earlier versions of the agent's settings. Click **Restore** on one to go back to it (a confirmation asks first).
- The **⋯** menu at the bottom of the panel has **Reset to default**. It clears all your changes to that agent and moves them to its history. It is greyed out when the agent has no changes.

**Voice:**

Pick the Executive's voice under **Voice** on **Settings → Your Executive**. The Council links there. To write your own voice, open the **Executive** card, click **Advanced settings** and go to the **Prompt** tab. In **Voice Persona**:

- **Active persona** picks the voice. It is saved with the panel's **Save** button.
- Edit the display name and **Persona body**, then click **Save persona**.
- **Reset to built-in** undoes your edits to a built-in persona.
- **Duplicate** makes a copy of the current persona and selects it.
- **Delete** removes a persona you created (built-in ones cannot be deleted).
- **+ New** asks for a display name and a persona body. Click **Create**.

**Example persona body:**

```
- Direct and brief; lead with the recommendation, then the reasoning
- Plain English, no jargon or buzzwords
- Numbers over adjectives
- End with the one decision you need from me
```

*Note: changes take effect on the next message. No restart is needed.*
